children: Spruce Power appointed Benjamin Rosenzweig to its Board effective upon the effective date of Clara Nagy McBane’s resignation.

Effective upon satisfaction of contingencies (referred to as the “Effective Date”) — contingencies include agreement on treatment of outstanding equity awards and confirmation of indemnification and D&O coverage
Effective upon the Effective Date of Ms. McBane’s resignation
Not disclosed (resignation contingent on satisfaction of specified conditions)
To fill vacancy created by Ms. McBane’s resignation
Replaced by Benjamin Rosenzweig upon Effective Date
Employed by Steel Partners Holdings L.P., an affiliate of SP Strategic Holdings LLC, a holder of ~17.8% of the Company’s common stock
